source_record.title: (Senior) Sales Manager:in Wholesale & B2B (m/f/d) – 40h/week
source_record.description:
General Description

As (Senior) Sales Manager Wholesale & B2B, you are a key pillar of our sales team and responsible for establishing and expanding our wholesale and B2B partnerships. You independently manage a portfolio of national and international key accounts, develop new business relationships, and ensure that our brand is present with the right partners.


Your Role

  • Independent management and strategic development of a portfolio of wholesale and B2B key accounts

  • Acquisition and onboarding of new partners in the retail, concept store, and corporate segments

  • Negotiation and closure of commercial contracts as well as terms negotiations with buyers and decision-makers

  • Development and implementation of tailored sales strategies for different channels and markets

  • Preparation and presentation of proposals, order sheets, and seasonal presentations

  • Close collaboration with internal departments (e.g., Marketing, Finance, Logistics, and Product Management) to ensure smooth order processing

  • Maintenance and structured documentation of all customer data and sales processes in CRM (Salesforce)

  • Market and competitor monitoring as well as identification of new sales opportunities


Your Skills and Experience

  • At least 3–5 years of professional experience in B2B sales or wholesale, ideally in the premium fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or travel goods industry

  • High motivation to achieve goals and drive growth

  • Experience managing key accounts and steering complex sales processes

  • Strong negotiation skills and closing ability at decision-maker level

  • Structured, independent way of working

  • Analytical mindset and data-driven approach

  • Confident handling of CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) as well as MS Office / Google Workspace, etc.

  • Interest in AI-driven tools and digital process optimization

  • Passion for smart, innovative products, quality, and design

  • Fluent in written and spoken German and English


What we offer

  • A company culture based on team spirit, personal responsibility, innovation, and diversity.

  • A collaborative working environment with a team of motivated, talented, and visionary colleagues who support you at all times.

  • The opportunity to take on responsibility and shape the future of our growing company on an international level.

  • A competitive salary plus an attractive monthly bonus.

  • Additional tax-free benefit for public transport, alternatively a USC membership, or a shopping voucher for a selection of retailers, as well as access to corporate benefits programs.

  • As a team of passionate travelers, we support your love for travel with 20 vacation days per year.

  • A Horizn Studios welcome package to equip you perfectly for your next journey.

  • Great employee discounts on our products.


Sounds like you?

Please send us your CV – along with a few words on why you think you should come on board, and your earliest possible start date. We look forward to hearing from you!
